authNote: Every operation's OpenAPI doc says 'Authorization: Bearer [access_token]' — that is WRONG for the personal-access API key this project uses. Empirically confirmed working: 'Authorization: token <key>'. Bearer returns HTTP 400 {"code":200058,"message":"User in token does not exist."}. See specs/rest/index.json.

operations.description:
Returns a page of calendar entries (Tasks and Appointments) for the caller, optionally filtered by leadId, type and completion status.

Notes:
- At least one of startTime or endTime is required; requests missing both return 400 INVALID_PARAMETER.
- includeFinished=true returns both finished and unfinished entries; includeFinished=false returns only unfinished.
- Results are wrapped under the 'data' key, which also carries pagination metadata.

parameters.name: leadId
parameters.description: Lead ID (optional, filter by specific lead)

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time, ISO 8601 with offset. At least one of startTime or endTime is required.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time, ISO 8601 with offset. At least one of startTime or endTime is required.

parameters.name: startTimeMs
parameters.description: Start time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Used when startTime is not provided.

parameters.name: endTimeMs
parameters.description: End time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Used when endTime is not provided.

parameters.name: timeZoneCode
parameters.description: Timezone code (IANA format, e.g., America/Los_Angeles)

parameters.name: includeFinished
parameters.description: Include finished calendars

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (starts from 0)

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Page size (max 500)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field (e.g., startTime)

parameters.name: desc
parameters.description: Sort in descending order

parameters.name: sourceType
parameters.description: Filter by source type codes. Multiple values allowed.

operations.description:
Creates either a Task or an Appointment for the target lead, selected by the 'type' field (case-insensitive TASK / APPOINTMENT).

Notes:
- Caller must have manage permission on the lead; otherwise 400 PERMISSION_DENIED (20017).
- type, leadId, content, startAt and endAt are required. taskWay is additionally required when type = TASK.
- startAt and endAt must be later than the current server time.
- The returned data.id is a composite string ('`<numericId>`-task' or '`<numericId>`-appointment') and must be used as-is when updating, finishing or deleting this entry.
- When startAt and endAt are both exactly midnight (00:00:00) in their declared offsets, an appointment is automatically marked as all-day.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: application/json

operations.description:
Returns available meeting time slots within the given time range, sorted by startTime ascending.

Notes:
- Either startTime (ISO 8601) or startTimeMs (millisecond timestamp) must be provided; same for endTime / endTimeMs. When both forms are provided for a field, the string form takes precedence.
- The resolved start time must be later than the current server time.
- The resolved end time must be later than the resolved start time.
- The range between start and end must not exceed 90 days.
- At most 'limit' slots are returned; the envelope also includes the total count.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format with offset. Preferred over startTimeMs when both are provided.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: End time in ISO 8601 format with offset. Preferred over endTimeMs when both are provided.

parameters.name: startTimeMs
parameters.description: Start time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Used when startTime is not provided.

parameters.name: endTimeMs
parameters.description: End time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Used when endTime is not provided.

parameters.name: timeZoneCode
parameters.description: IANA timezone identifier. When omitted, the caller's configured timezone is used.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of slots to return.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: Composite calendar ID of the form '`<numericId>`-task' or '`<numericId>`-appointment'.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: application/json

operations.description:
Partially updates a Task or Appointment. Only non-empty fields in the request body are applied; omitted fields keep their current values.

Notes:
- calendarId must be the composite string returned by POST /v2.0/calendar (e.g. '12345-task' or '12345-appointment'). Invalid format returns 400.
- When startAt or endAt is supplied, it must be later than the current server time.

parameters.name: calendarId
parameters.description: Composite calendar ID returned by POST /v2.0/calendar, of the form '`<numericId>`-task' or '`<numericId>`-appointment'.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: application/json
